question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

Season the meat with salt and pepper, and then fry it __in a hot pan__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **No improvement**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"No improvement"** is used when the original sentence is already correct and doesn't require any changes. (कोई सुधार नहीं)
 
• **Example: **The sentence** "The sky is blue"** requires no improvement because it is grammatically correct.
 
• The given sentence, "Season the meat with salt and pepper, and then fry it in a hot pan," is already grammatically correct and doesn't need any changes. (हिंदी: दिए गए वाक्य "Season the meat with salt and pepper, and then fry it in a hot pan," में कोई सुधार की आवश्यकता नहीं है क्योंकि यह व्याकरणिक रूप से सही है।)
 
• **Example: **Season the meat with salt and pepper, and then fry it in a hot pan. (हिंदी: मांस को नमक और काली मिर्च के साथ सीज़न करें, और फिर इसे गर्म पैन में फ्राई करें।)

Therefore, the correct answer is: **No improvement**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **in a hottest pan** (सबसे गर्म पैन में): This phrase is grammatically incorrect.

 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect usage: Fry the meat in a hottest pan. (हिंदी: सबसे गर्म पैन में मांस को फ्राई करें।)
 
 
 
• **to hotter pan** (गर्म पैन के लिए): This phrase is incorrect in the given context.
 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect usage: Transfer the meat to hotter pan. (हिंदी: मांस को गर्म पैन में स्थानांतरित करें।)
 
 
 
• **at a heat pan** (एक गर्म पैन में): This phrase is grammatically incorrect.
 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect usage: Cook the meat at a heat pan. (हिंदी: मांस को एक गर्म पैन में पकाएं।)
 
 

3a:Td99,
The correct answer is **Option 4**.
